description: Publish, unpublish, or delete one or more CMS posts (1-25) by id. Use a single-element post_ids for one post. Returns per-id succeeded/failed; one bad id never aborts the batch. Delete needs delete scope. Publish is rules-gated: force overrides warning-only refusals.

force.description: publish only: override warning-only rules refusals.

name: bulk_cms_posts
